description.value: Steelhead Valhalla Lodge is a remote wilderness fishing lodge situated on the banks of the Sustut River in Northern BC, accessible only by floatplane from Smithers. The operation centers on guided steelhead fishing with jet boats on the lower 18 miles of the Sustut, with five hand-hewn log cabins (built in the 1950s, fully renovated in 2017-2018) each featuring a private bathroom, wood stove, and river views. The lodge runs a full from-scratch culinary program and maintains a repeat booking rate of nearly 95% among its fishing clientele.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Steelhead Valhalla Lodge is an active, operational fishing lodge on the Sustut River in Northern BC, with cabins renovated in 2017-2018 and a full culinary program. No mention of bicycles, bike storage, laundry, Wi-Fi, or any cycling-related amenities appears anywhere on the site; the focus is entirely on guided steelhead fishing. The lodge is described as a remote wilderness destination accessed by floatplane from Smithers, making it physically unreachable by bicycle, though it is a real, publicly bookable business.
concerns: Lodge is accessible only by floatplane or helicopter from Smithers — not reachable by bicycle or road, severely limiting practical utility in a cycling tourism directory.
Phone number carries a Montana (USA) area code (406), suggesting the owner/operator is US-based; OSM had no phone to cross-check.
Mailing address is a P.O. Box in Smithers, BC — the physical lodge on the Sustut River is far from this address; OSM had no address to cross-check.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operational, publicly bookable business with an active website and no closure indicators; the lack of cycling-specific amenities and remote location are not grounds for exclusion.

wow_evidence: accessible only by floatplane from Smithers
